findings.observed: Actual K06 failed after successful lifecycle POST, workflow GET and authorization GET; originalWorkflow.Status comparison expected 200.
findings.cause: Public GetCollaborationOperation intentionally omits status for successful receipt, while the new test decodes the body into an internal service receipt and expects Status==200.
findings.recommended_fix: Test owner should use the public response map, preserve HTTP200 plus omitted-status/code/revision/confirmation equality, and retain explicit status409 for refusal. Do not change the product DTO.
findings.handoff: ROOT assigned separate test-only repair owner /root/p2_k06_repair on a new source; original source and failed DB unchanged.

audit_limitations.reason: The existing canonical router fixture retains immutable M1 evidence/policies/authorizations/consumed terminal; post-run acceptance must bind exact retained facts, rather than demand an empty business history.
audit_limitations.reclassification: This audit assertion is separate from the actual original test exit1 and does not change its FAIL. All original receipts/raw remain unchanged.
